category_title: Students with visual impairments and no speech who use non-visual communication methods
scenario_title: Making story choices using a verbal communication book
minimal_context: Jane is participating in an iPad-based story-making activity where she needs to choose adjectives and plotlines for a character.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are working on our story on the iPad. Look at these photos. Should the character run quickly or walk slowly?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Jane cannot use the photos or the iPad in the same way as the others due to her eyesight. She makes a sound and indicates "no" to the choices.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, do you want the character to jump?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Those are the options we have right now. What should we do?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Jane makes use of the statement "None of the above" in her communication book because there were not enough choices given.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are working on our story on the iPad. Look at these photos. Should the character run quickly or walk slowly?

STUDENT: (Jane cannot use the photos or the iPad in the same way as the others due to her eyesight. She makes a sound and indicates "no" to the choices.)

TUTOR: Okay, do you want the character to jump?

STUDENT: (Jane indicates "no" to the question.)

TUTOR: Those are the options we have right now. What should we do?

STUDENT: (Jane makes use of the statement "None of the above" in her communication book because there were not enough choices given.)
